_comment: TICK-062 (#50). D-016's fallback chain is only a mitigation if the host and the demo laptop run the SAME image. Both digests are recorded here and checked by `python -m frontdoor_server.deployment verify`, which stays RED until the laptop has pulled the image.

laptop._how: docker pull registry.fly.io/frontdoor-measure:<release>, then docker inspect --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}' and take the registry.fly.io entry -- position 0 is not guaranteed to be it. Do NOT docker build: a local build is a different image.
